text: No, the tool didn’t confirm whether there *was* or *wasn’t* tree-cover loss on this asset (ASSET-J). The assessment is **INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE** because the required Earth-observation data (e.g., Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020) wasn’t available for this rural property. The tool couldn’t observe changes due to **missing coverage**, so it doesn’t establish either the presence or absence of loss—or any compliance status. The claim remains unanswered.
